bulkImportSteps.title: Bulk upload from Excel
bulkImportSteps.intro: Import Products and Variants together with their packaging materials in one Excel file, then import Recipes and Ingredients (optional). Each file is fully validated and saved atomically. Configure images in the product editor. Complete recipes and packaging before quoting.
bulkImportSteps.requires1: Step 1 · Products, Variants and materials — requires active Subcategories, Clients and Presentations; existing packaging codes and groups when materials are included.
bulkImportSteps.requires2: Step 2 · Recipes — references each product through a variant SKU from step 1; requires Raw Materials in their catalog.
bulkImportSteps.requires3: Step 3 · Ingredients (optional) — references each product through a variant SKU from step 1; requires Ingredients in their catalog.

bulkImport.title: Bulk upload Recipes from Excel
bulkImport.description: Download the template, fill it in with each product's recipe (one row per raw material) and upload it. The products must already exist (step 1) and each raw material is looked up by its code. Fixed recipe: fill in only "Porcentaje" (percentage) and the product's rows must total 100%. Customizable recipe: leave "Porcentaje" empty and optionally use "% mínimo"/"% máximo" (min/max); the raw materials must be mixable and the ranges must allow reaching 100%. The whole file is validated first: if a single row has an error, no recipe is created. This importer only CREATES recipes: a product that already has one is rejected (edit it from its screen). Identify each product using "SKU de una variante del producto" (SKU of a product variant). Recipes and ingredients are shared by all its variants; using different SKUs of the same product does not allow duplicate rows.

bulkImport.title: Bulk upload product Ingredients from Excel
bulkImport.description: Optional. Download the template, fill it in with each product's added ingredients (one row per ingredient) and upload it. The products must already exist (step 1) and each ingredient is looked up by its code. "Gramos" (grams) are the grams in a "Peso de referencia (g)" (reference weight) presentation (e.g. 40 g in 2000 g) and can't exceed that weight. The whole file is validated first: if a single row has an error, nothing is created. This importer only CREATES: a product that already has ingredients is rejected (edit them from its screen). Identify each product using "SKU de una variante del producto" (SKU of a product variant). Recipes and ingredients are shared by all its variants; using different SKUs of the same product does not allow duplicate rows.
